title:
Blue Pits Housing Action are hiring! 📢 ❗️

Do you fancy a rewarding career in Social Care? 

For the full job advert or to request an application form please contact our office via telephone 01706 345886 - who will  email this to you, or you can collect one from our main office! 

SUPPORT WORKER POSTS 
o 2 x 40 hours a week - including evenings and weekends
o Part time roles will be considered

 Salary £25,000 * per annum (full time equivalent role). The salary will be pro-rated based on the number of hours worked for part time candidates. 
 Start date September 2024
 Rochdale area –  Car Driver/User essential 
 PPE provided for all roles
 Internal and external applicants considered

*Please note the inbox on this page is not monitored*
